name: search
description: Search memory for relevant notes using semantic similarity. If you have not called read_instructions in this conversation, call it first.

namespace.description: Namespace to search (default: agent namespace, "*" for all)

name: save_note
description: Save a note to memory. Creates a new note — fails if slug already exists (use edit_note to update). Auto-indexes into vector DB. If you have not called read_instructions in this conversation, call it first.

slug.description: URL slug (auto-generated from title if omitted)

name: list_notes
description: List all notes in a namespace

prefix.description: Filter by slug prefix (e.g., "notes/" to list only notes in that path). Results sorted by slug when prefix is used.

name: read_note
description:
Read a note's content. Returns the full content by default. For large notes, use `offset` (1-indexed line number) and `limit` (line count, default 2000 when offset is given, max 10000) to paginate; paginated responses are prefixed with `[lines N-M of TOTAL]

` (or `[lines N- of TOTAL]

` with an empty body when offset is past end). If you have not called read_instructions in this conversation, call it first.

offset.description: 1-indexed line number to start reading from. If limit is also absent, the full note is returned unpaginated.

limit.description: Max lines to return. Defaults to 2000 when offset is supplied. Hard cap: 10000.

name: delete_note
description: Delete a note by slug (also removes vector chunks)

name: restore_note
description: Restore a previously deleted note. Recovers the most recently deleted version and its vector chunks.

name: edit_note
description: Edit a note by replacing a specific text string. Like search-and-replace — finds old_string in the note and replaces it with new_string. Fails if old_string is not found or appears more than once (unless replace_all is true).

old_string.description: The exact text to find and replace

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences (default: false — requires old_string to be unique)

name: move_note
description: Move/rename a note by changing its slug. Also updates associated vector chunks. Optionally move to a different namespace.

new_namespace.description: Target namespace (optional, defaults to current namespace)

name: move_folder
description: Bulk-move notes by slug prefix: every note whose slug starts with from_prefix is rewritten to to_prefix (e.g. "tasks/x/" → "tasks/done/x/"). Bulk alternative to move_note. Prefix match is literal, not path-aware — end prefixes with "/" so you don't catch siblings like "tasks/x-other". Refuses on a destination collision unless overwrite_slugs is set; dry_run previews.

from_prefix.description: Source slug prefix to move from (e.g. "tasks/dev-2337/")

to_prefix.description: Destination slug prefix to move to (e.g. "tasks/done/dev-2337/"). May be empty string to move notes to the namespace root.

dry_run.description: Preview only: report how many notes would move and which destination slugs conflict, without changing anything (default: false)

overwrite_slugs.description: Destination slugs to soft-delete before moving, to resolve conflicts. Any conflict not listed here is skipped (its source note stays put). Omit to refuse the move when conflicts exist.

name: grep
description: Search notes for text matches (case-insensitive). Returns matching lines with line numbers and ±2 lines of surrounding context by default. Widen or narrow the window with `context_before`/`context_after` (or `context` for both); max 50 lines per direction, `context: 0` disables context entirely. Pass `regex: true` to treat the pattern as a JavaScript regex (still case-insensitive); default is an exact substring. Output format: match lines prefixed `> NNNN: `, context lines prefixed `  NNNN: `, notes separated by `---`, non-contiguous context blocks within a single note separated by `--`.

pattern.description: Text to search for. Case-insensitive substring by default; treated as a regex when regex=true.

namespace.description: Namespace to search (default: agent namespace, "*" for all)

context_before.description: Lines of context before each match (default: 2, max: 50)

context_after.description: Lines of context after each match (default: 2, max: 50)

context.description: Symmetric shortcut setting both context_before and context_after. Specific params win when both are supplied.

regex.description: Treat pattern as a case-insensitive JavaScript regex (default: false). Patterns are length-capped at 200 chars and screened for catastrophic-backtracking shapes (ReDoS); unsafe patterns return 400.

name: read_instructions
description: Read your startup instructions, context, and identity documents (including your soul document when dream processing is enabled). Call this at the start of every conversation, before anything else.

name: save_instructions
description: Save your startup instructions. These are read at session start to configure your behavior. Overwrites any existing instructions.

name: chat_send
description: Send a chat message to another agent. Use to="*" to broadcast to all registered agents.

discussion_id.description: Send to all joined participants in a discussion (alternative to "to"). Resolves recipients from joined participants.

name: chat_receive
description: Check for unread chat messages. Returns unacked messages. Call chat_ack with the IDs after processing.

agent.description: Agent to check messages for (default: configured agent)

discussion_id.description: Filter to messages from a specific discussion.

name: chat_ack
description: Acknowledge specific chat messages as read. Acked messages will not appear in future receives.

ids.description: Array of message IDs to ack (from receive results)

name: chat_status
description: Get chat status for an agent: pending message count, last message time, last ack time.

agent.description: Agent to check status for (default: configured agent)

discussion_id.description: Filter to a specific discussion. Omit for regular chat only.

name: mail_send
description: Send mail to another agent. Mail is stored in the API database until the recipient acks it. Returns the mail UUID — save it to match replies via in_reply_to.

in_reply_to.description: UUID of the message this is replying to (for threading)

name: mail_check
description: List unread mail with subject, sender, date, and body preview (no full body). Use this to see what is waiting, then call mail_receive with specific IDs to read individual messages.

agent.description: Agent to check mail for (default: configured agent)

name: mail_receive
description: Read full mail content by ID. Requires specific message IDs — use mail_check first to list unread mail and get IDs, then call this with those IDs, then mail_ack after processing.

agent.description: Agent to check mail for (default: configured agent)

ids.description: Mail UUIDs to read (required — get these from mail_check)

name: mail_ack
description: Manually ack specific mail messages by UUID. Use this if mail_receive failed after downloading but before acking.

ids.description: Array of mail UUIDs to ack

name: mail_edit
description: Edit an unsent (unacked) mail message. Only the sender can edit, and only before the recipient acks it. Use to fix mistakes in mail you just sent.

name: mail_unsend
description: Unsend (delete) a mail message you sent, before the recipient acks it. Only the sender can unsend.

name: mail_sent
description: Get mail you have sent. Returns sent messages with delivery status (whether recipient has acked).

agent.description: Agent to check sent mail for (default: configured agent)

name: mail_history
description: Get previously received and acked mail. Returns your read inbox history.

agent.description: Agent to check history for (default: configured agent)

name: agent_status
description: Get presence info for all agents: online/offline status, last seen time, expertise areas, and unread chat/mail counts for the querying agent.

agent.description: Agent requesting presence info (default: configured agent). Unread counts are relative to this agent.

name: update_expertise
description: Update your areas of expertise. Other agents see this when deciding who to include in discussions.

name: update_profile
description: Update your agent profile (provider and/or model). Provider is the AI company (e.g. "anthropic", "openai"). Model is the specific model (e.g. "claude-4-sonnet", "gpt-5.3-codex").

name: activity_start
description: Signal that you are actively working on a task. Shows an activity indicator to other agents and in the admin dashboard.

name: activity_stop
description: Signal that you have finished working. Clears the activity indicator.

name: discussion_create
description: Create a new discussion with specified participants. Creator is auto-added as joined; others are invited.

participants.description: List of participant agent names (must include creator)

mode.description: Discussion mode: "realtime" (transport + subagent, live back-and-forth) or "async" (independent investigation + direct voting). Default: realtime

context.description: Optional background/context for the discussion (max 10k chars). Visible to joining agents via discussion_status.

name: discussion_list
description: List discussions, optionally filtered by status and/or agent.

status.description: Filter by status: active, concluded, timed_out

agent.description: Filter to discussions this agent participates in

name: discussion_status
description: Get full status of a discussion: details, participants, and votes.

name: discussion_pending
description: Check for discussions needing attention: pending invitations and open votes awaiting your ballot.

agent.description: Agent to check for (default: configured agent)

name: discussion_conclude
description: Manually conclude an active discussion.

name: discussion_cancel
description: Cancel an active or waiting discussion. Sets status to cancelled and outcome to abandoned.

name: discussion_join
description: Join a discussion you have been invited to.

name: discussion_leave
description: Leave a discussion you are participating in.

name: discussion_defer
description: Defer a discussion invitation for later. Acknowledges the invitation without joining, pauses the timeout clock. Can re-defer up to a configurable maximum (default: 3). Resume later by calling discussion_join.

name: discussion_vote_propose
description: Propose a vote in a discussion. Use type "conclude" for ending the discussion, "general" for other decisions. Choices are integers; describe options in the question text.

closes_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp when vote auto-closes

name: discussion_vote_cast
description: Cast a ballot on an open vote. Choice is an integer matching the options in the question.

choice.description: Integer choice (matching options in the question)

name: discussion_vote_status
description: Get status and ballots for a specific vote.
